observe.surface: the Swiftie Quiz main window (Tauri webview) in the affected GamePhase: menu, album-select, quiz-type-select, lyrics-mode-select, difficulty-select, lyrics-loading, playing, cat-gallery, settings; plus the native install and update prompts on macOS and Windows
observe.value: the rendered state of the specific control the report names (question text, answer options, score, timer, clip playback, unlocked cat, setting value) and, for persistence, the GameProgress JSON written to the app data dir
observe.observe_by: deep checks: VMLab (`lab` CLI, vm-lab skill) driving the packaged app on fresh macOS 26 and Windows 11 copies via screenshot, click, type and exec; logic: Vitest + Testing Library for src/, cargo test + mockito for src-tauri/; a manual `npm run tauri dev` run on this Mac is a personal formality, never the deep check
observe.terminal_action: the action that commits the effect at the end of the flow: answering the final question so the round transitions to results and save_progress persists GameProgress; for settings, the change surviving an app restart; for the updater, the downloaded update installing and the app relaunching on the new version
observe.build_artifact: a bundle built from the commit under test: `npm run tauri build` locally or the CI build-job artifact (dmg/.app on macOS aarch64, NSIS setup.exe on Windows x86_64), installed into the VMLab copy; for releases, the release.yml draft-release assets for tag vX.Y.Z with package.json, Cargo.toml and tauri.conf.json versions equal
observe.twin: TS types in src/types/index.ts and Rust DTOs in src-tauri/src/models/*.rs (four-place rule: struct, impl Default, interface, DEFAULT_PROGRESS); the version string in package.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml and src-tauri/tauri.conf.json; the build steps duplicated between .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml; sound vs lyrics quiz types sharing engine code
observe.dependent: frontend hooks in src/hooks/ that invoke the 7 Tauri commands; the save migration in src-tauri/src/commands/storage.rs for any GameProgress change; the auto-updater (latest.json on GitHub releases, minisign pubkey in tauri.conf.json, updater:default capability) for any release.yml or bundle config change; the Deezer and LRCLIB public APIs for commands/deezer.rs and commands/lyrics.rs
observe.receipt: a Vitest test (src/**/*.test.ts[x]) or a cargo test (mockito for HTTP) that asserts the reported symptom, red before the fix and green after; for user-facing behaviour, additionally a re-runnable VMLab script or step list that installs the build and reaches the terminal action on both macOS and Windows
observe.compat_boundary: the on-disk save file (GameProgress version in src-tauri/src/models/progress.rs, migrated in storage.rs): a new build must read saves written by every shipped version; installed clients verifying updates with the embedded minisign pubkey and fetching releases/latest/download/latest.json; Deezer and LRCLIB response shapes, which change without notice

reach.access: `npm run tauri dev` on this Mac for quick looks; deep verification installs the packaged build into fresh VMLab macOS and Windows 11 copies (`lab up macos`, `lab up windows`, `lab install`, `lab open`). No accounts or credentials anywhere; Deezer and LRCLIB are public.
reach.shortcut: none needed: every phase is a few clicks from the menu
reach.fixtures: a clean install works for gameplay; achievement and cat-gallery states need a hand-edited GameProgress JSON placed in the app data dir before launch
special_surfaces: all user-facing functionality: live e2e in VMLab on macOS and Windows is mandatory for deep checks; manual testing on this Mac is a shallow personal look only
audio clip playback (Web Audio, smart-clip timing)
auto-update flow (needs a published release with signed latest.json and an older installed build)
first-install prompts (macOS Gatekeeper Open Anyway for the ad-hoc signed app, Windows SmartScreen for the unsigned NSIS installer)
